Solution 06 — Real Estate

Listings, leads, and a brand that follow the deal.

Management systems, lead automation, and identity for property businesses. Built for developers, agencies, and property managers whose listings, leads, and sales pipelines currently live across phones and notebooks.

Book a Consultation
01 — The Context

What property businesses typically face.

Developers, agencies, and property managers run listings, leads, and sales pipelines across phones and notebooks. The system should follow the deal, not the other way around.

Every enquiry that arrives on WhatsApp or through a portal has to be captured, followed up, and tracked to handover, and every agent has to present the same brand while doing it. ZEHNOX builds the management system, automates the follow-up, and sets the identity, so the operation holds together across every listing and every agent.

02 — What ZEHNOX Provides

Three services, bundled for real estate.

Software Solutions carries the management system and portal; AI Automation carries lead capture and follow-up; Web & Digital carries identity and the website. Each bundle links to its service page, where the full sub-service list, approach, and FAQ live.
